description.Un marco de acrílico de 20 × 25 cm para:
A 20 × 25 cm (8 × 10 in) acrylic frame for your display photo. No screen, no battery, no cables: there is an NFC chip in the base, so you just hold your phone close to open your digital album with photos and a voice message.

You design the photo: pick the image, the template and your race details, then download the file at the exact size of the frame, ready to print.

You activate it only once, from the app or the website, with the code that comes in the box. You decide who can see the album.
